sloka: प्रतिगृह्य तु ताम् पूजाम् ऋषि दत्ताम् प्रतापवान् ।रामम् दाशरथिम् रामो जामदग्न्यो अभ्यभाषत ॥१-७४-२४॥
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tām pūjām ṛṣi dattām pratāpavān ।rāmam dāśarathim rāmo jāmadagnyo abhyabhāṣata ॥1-74-24॥

translations.english: The saints having thus talked amongst themselves, offered arghya to the son of Bhargava, of dreadful appearance and addressed him in soothing words: "O Rama O Rama".
